reviews.reason: Chunky faceted white-teal-rust padlock with bolts on a flat magenta background, no text, no shadow, no enemy or reserved colour (A1, A6, A7); the shackle is short and the body wide, so it reads a little less instantly as a padlock than variant 2.
Classic padlock silhouette with a tall shackle and a high-contrast keyhole, white-teal-rust plates and rivets, flat magenta background with no shadow or text (A1, A6, A7).
Side-view rifle in white, teal and rust with a white-gold muzzle tip on a flat background, no text, no enemy colour (A6, A7, A8); the open-frame stock and thin barrel will thin out at 120 x 50 px.
Side-view rifle with solid blocky stock and handguard plates in white, teal and rust, white-gold muzzle tip, flat background, no text or shadow (A1, A6, A7, A8).

Pump shotgun with a wide barrel over a ribbed teal pump tube, white-teal-rust plates, white-gold muzzle glow, no text, no enemy colour (A1, A6, A7, A8); the starburst flare spills a few pixels onto the magenta, which no A rule covers but will leave a fringe at cut-out.

Short wide-bore gun with ribbed pump tube in white, teal and rust, white-gold muzzle glow, no text, no enemy colour (A1, A6, A7, A8); the fat single bore reads closer to a flare or grenade launcher than variant 1, and its soft halo tints the magenta around the muzzle (no A rule covers this).
Turret on a splayed tripod base with a long teal-white barrel and white-gold bore glow, player colours with rust, flat background, no text or shadow (A4, A6, A7, A8).
Low, wide turret on a tripod with a carry handle and a short thick barrel, white-teal-rust plates, white-gold bore glow, flat background, no text or shadow (A1, A4, A6, A7, A8).
